title: I found the perfect Glass Pitcher that seals but this is not it!
text: I found the perfect Glass Pitcher that seals but this is not it!. This pitcher looks nice and the handle is a little too big but the problem is that it does not seal at all.  This company is pushy and makes you feel bad for not liking their pitcher and tries to make you leave a good review like they are small time and need your help to get going with their false advertising. The holes in the lid for the spout even when turned to the side can still get air or leak if tipped.  A fly could get in there.  I have to have a tight seal for my distilled water, distilled tea or for my raw milk.  This does not take care of my needs.  I wouldn't want air in any of my drinks.  I did find a pitcher on Amazon that worked great for me.  It is the Bormioli Rocco Hermetic Seal Glass Pitcher.  It holds 68 ounces easily with some room and seals tightly.  A little shorter and fatter but works perfect in my frig.  You have to completely take off the lid to pour and I am good with that because it seals!  Look up the Bormioli Rocco Hermetic Seal Glass Pitcher.
